scope: One future bounded non-system WLAN IOMapper consuming the unchanged approved C codec; no implementation or activation claim
source_identity: Six primary interface/consumer files below were byte-compared to the exact baseline Git objects; unchanged. Other cited files were inspected locally as source.

saved_ADT.selection: WLAN iommu-parent four-byte OSData0x50 equals mapper-apcie0-wlan child phandle; DART hardware phandle0x4f and BT child0x51 are different. No SID inferred.

concrete_findings.finding: Base start calls initHardware, copies provider identity, does not registerService; copyMapper waits indefinitely by default. Publish correct OSData child identity only after real readiness; keep unavailable consumers behind their own gate.

Unmap errors can be discarded and caller allocation state/references are cleared. Returning timeout is not a backing-lifetime solution; independent retention plus real containment/fail-stop is mandatory.
Full page-list fast path rebuilds specification without device. Explicit per-requester mapper and owned-buffer registry are required; missing mapper must never become implicit physical DMA.
mapToPhysicalAddress has no error channel and consumers use the return value directly as a PA. Invalid lookup cannot return identity or zero as a success-shaped sentinel.
setBusMasterEnable returns previous command-bit state, not checked disable or transaction-drain proof.

256 leaves/4MiB,129 tables, canonical whole16K pages and no physical aliases constrain the entire owned graph. Codec byte serialization is for unpublished RAM, not an atomic live-PTE publication primitive.

proposed_initial_limits.backing: approved owned wired kernel-only whole16K pages

remaining_activation_blockers: Normal DART MMIO clock/reset prerequisites remain unresolved; separate dart-mmio-prerequisites-source-review.json remains authoritative.
No actual exclusive RID/SID/root and fault-controller ownership or PCI DMA admission gate.
No proven target page-table cache visibility, stream invalidation completion or requester transaction drain.
No safe unmap-timeout continuation through pinned consumer semantics; retention alone cannot pin arbitrary pageable caller memory.
MSI forwarding and doorbell handling are separate work; exclusion is not a mapping implementation.
No SDK/import/ABI or runtime proof for the proposed adapter.
